headline: Cooling Real Estate Market Shaves $5 Billion Off Victoria's Budget
summary: Lower stamp duty and land tax revenue will reduce Victoria's tax take by an average of $1.3 billion annually over four years, delivering a $5 billion blow to the Australian state's fiscal outlook.
why: Australian state budgets rely heavily on property transfer stamp duties, making fiscal positions sensitive to housing turnover and price trends.

impacts.name: Australian Real Estate
impacts.why: Subdued transaction volumes reduce property-linked tax collections and dampen construction sector momentum.
